title: Rolling 1h Hurst (DFA) regime gate on the RSI divergence and the swing-fade trades

what.name: Idea
what.value_plain: Mean-reversion trades should work better when the market has been anti-persistent (low Hurst H) and worse when it trends.
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Hurst estimate
what.value_plain: DFA-1 on 480 hourly returns, scales 8 to 160, known at the close of its last bar (FORMULAS.md s27)
what.label: SOURCED

what.name: Trades gated
what.value_plain: The 640 RSI divergence events of P1b and the 7,416 F1 pivot-fade trades; outcomes unchanged, fees as in those studies
what.label: OURS

what.name: Test
what.value_plain: Lift = mean net R of kept minus removed, week-block bootstrap 95 % CI; shuffled-H, random-gate and circular-shift nulls; two time splits
what.label: OURS

what.name: Planted edge
what.value_plain: +0.25 R on kept RSI events must be found by the family-wise null (it was not: kept n too small)
what.label: OURS

how: No trade is re-run. Each frozen trade list gets the H value known at its entry time, is split into kept and removed by the gate, and the difference in mean net R is tested against three nulls. Events in the first 20 days (no H yet) are dropped and counted.
window: DEV 2022-01-01 to 2025-06-30 (files after 2025-06 never opened; HOLDOUT untouched)

verdict.label: Negative: no gate test passes; the low-H gate points the wrong way on the fade

why: Best lift is +0.123 R [-0.109, +0.358] (RSI, gate B), not different from zero.
On the fade, gate A lifts -0.062 R (CI upper bound -0.0006, borderline wrong way); with 4 tests that is not a finding on its own.
Every kept side stays negative after fees (best -0.20 R), so even a real lift would not make a tradable gate.
The RSI tests are underpowered: the pre-registered +0.25 R plant was not flagged with only 119 kept events. Read them as 'not shown', not 'absent'.
The 0.45 and 0.55 cut-offs are vendor anecdote on a 20-day window; other windows or thresholds are new trials. No gate added.
